title: Scrum: ceremonies, definition of done and testing inside the sprint

videos.script: Scrum is small. Three accountabilities, five events, three artefacts, in thirteen pages. {{small}} And one thing in it surprises testers. There is no tester role. {{role}} Everyone who builds the increment is a Developer, whatever their specialism. The team is accountable for the testing, together. {{together}} So where does a tester do the job? In every event. Questions at planning, before anyone commits. What is waiting for testing, at the daily scrum. The product in front of its users, at the review. And at the retrospective, one question about every defect. Why was it possible? {{events}} Then the definition of done. One bar, written down, that every story has to clear. {{done}} And acceptance criteria, which say what one story has to do, best written as examples a tester can check. {{end}}
